and certify such deletion to Customer in writing
transition assistance for up to 6 months (exceeds 90 days)
in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination

reasons: All atomic preferred elements are present in operative language: 6-month assistance window, then-current rates, 30-day return in a standard machine-readable format running from expiry or termination, and deletion followed by written certification.

The 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance (a customary trigger for optional services) and does not gate the mandatory data return, deletion, or certification duties, so the request condition does not swallow the return obligation.

The enumeration 'including all Content, Requests and other data of or relating to Customer then in Kubient's possession or control' anchors the otherwise undefined 'Customer Data' to defined terms in the Agreement, so it is a functional clarification rather than surplus drafting; the insertion adds sub-clauses (v)-(vii) without rewriting existing (i)-(iv).

Untouched terms (cessation of Services, licence revocation, Confidential Information return/destruction) remain effective; no contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced, since deletion is expressly sequenced after return.
Clause is compliant at the preferred level; no further redline is warranted.
